intro.text: Vell drew this island from the cliff the night the survey ship stopped answering.
She was right about the shape of it. She did not come back.

intro.speaker: Olrik
intro.text: Then we walk it. Waker, you are on point.

lines.speaker: Vell
lines.text: You are standing at the drop. Everything from here is inland.

lines.speaker: Vell
lines.text: Hold W to walk north, A and D to go sideways. S goes back the way you came.

lines.speaker: Vell
lines.text: Good. You can walk. That was the part I was worried about.

lines.speaker: Vell
lines.text: Press E when I am close enough. Talking is how this island still tells us anything.

lines.speaker: Vell
lines.text: South-west, at the old waypoint. There is a cache under the stone slab.

lines.speaker: Vell
lines.text: Whatever is in it is the only reason we get a second fight.

stages.goal: Open the menu with Esc, then the Items tab

lines.speaker: Olrik
lines.text: Esc opens the menu, and the Items tab is what you are carrying.

lines.speaker: Vell
lines.text: In a fight they are a row in the command list, same as a skill.

lines.speaker: Vell
lines.text: They hold the meadow. Not clever, just four of them and not afraid.

lines.speaker: Vell
lines.text: When the command list opens, the arrows move and Enter confirms.

stages.goal: Break the Stone Sentinel on the mesa

lines.speaker: Vell
lines.text: Then there is the Sentinel. It has stood on that mesa since the boat stopped.

lines.speaker: Vell
lines.text: It is immune to lightning and hard with everything else. Tess, ice, and only ice.

lines.speaker: Vell
lines.text: So it was a person. I had started to think of it as weather.

lines.speaker: Vell
lines.text: The island is ours. The plateau is climbable now, whatever it was holding.

lines.speaker: Olrik
lines.text: Then we go up. And we do not stop at the top this time.

progress.completeText: The Wake of the Cartographer, complete
